candidates.statement: Checkout 502s originate downstream: gateway POST /v1/checkout returns 502 because order returns 502, and order's payment call to /v1/authorizations returns 503 (STATUS_CODE_ERROR). Inventory reservation succeeds (200). The failing hop is order->payment, surfacing as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 but no payment-side logs/metrics; whether payment is unhealthy vs. rejecting is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are explained by a downstream chain: order returns 502 to gateway, and order's payment authorization call returns 503. Inventory reservation succeeds. Metrics show ~10.7 checkout 502s vs 2.7 200s in 60s. Root cause is bounded to the order->payment hop; payment-side evidence is missing.
